subject.title: Cron "New Job" form misaligns the Description field after interacting with Agent ID

question: Should this report be transferred to openclaw/openclaw, or can a maintainer identify a supported ClawHub route that contains the reported Cron form?
rationale: Source and release evidence show the form is absent from ClawHub, while OpenClaw history confirms ownership of the Cron editor; a maintainer must authorize the repository transfer or identify an unlocated supported surface.

options.title: Transfer to OpenClaw
options.body: Move or recreate the report in openclaw/openclaw with current browser proof and the exact route and source path.

options.title: Identify ClawHub ownership
options.body: Keep it in ClawHub only if maintainers can name a supported branch or route containing this form and provide a reproducible fixture.

recommendation.title: Transfer to OpenClaw
recommendation.body: Move or recreate the report in openclaw/openclaw with current browser proof and the exact route and source path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history makes this the strongest available ClawHub-side contact for confirming the dashboard boundary and routing the report to its actual owner.
